subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Out of the blue
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unexpectedly**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**out of the blue**" means something that happens unexpectedly, without warning or preparation. (कुछ ऐसा जो बिना किसी चेतावनी या तैयारी के अप्रत्याशित रूप से घटित होता है)
 
• This idiom is often used to describe a sudden event or surprise that comes out of nowhere.
 
 
• **Example**: I was sitting at home when out of the blue
